title: MAGI-2：单次生成 30 秒带声音的 1080p AI 视频，登顶排行榜
author: Ai Game Changer Pro
content:
AI video just took a leap. Sand.ai's MAGI-2 can generate 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronised sound — dialogue, lip sync, foley and music — in a single pass, no editing required. It now sits at the top of the Artificial Analysis Video Arena leaderboard, and you can try it for $0.08 a second on Higgsfield. Here is what makes MAGI-2 different, and how to use it.

What is MAGI-2?

MAGI-2 is a video generation model from Sand.ai that produces up to 30 seconds of 1080p video at 25 frames per second — with native audio baked in. Dialogue, sound effects and music are generated together with the picture, in one pass. Until now, most AI video tools made silent clips and left the sound to a second tool. MAGI-2 removes that step entirely.

The leaderboard

On the Artificial Analysis Video Arena (v2.1), MAGI-2 leads the field with an Elo score of 1150.3, ahead of Kling 2.1, Hailuo, VEO 3 and Seedance. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video, so you can start from a prompt, a still image or an existing clip.

The model

Under the hood, MAGI-2 is a mixture-of-experts design: 480 billion parameters in total, with 28 billion activated per token. That scale is what lets it hold a scene together for 30 seconds — characters, camera moves and sound all staying consistent.

How to use it

The easiest way to try MAGI-2 right now is on Higgsfield, where it costs $0.08 per second — about $2.40 for a full 30-second clip. Sand.ai has promised open weights, but they have not been released yet, so the hosted version is the only option for now.

The bottom line

Thirty seconds of 1080p video with sound, in one pass, at the top of the charts: MAGI-2 is the new bar for AI video. The open-weights release, when it comes, will decide how far it spreads.

Originally published on Ai Game Changer Pro.
